The '''Second Battle of Omonoth''' was a battle fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] fought over the remains of the derelict ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]'', but the battle was inconclusive.
